clue.text: Non-rural pope

definitions.meaning: belonging to the town or city rather than the countryside
eight popes have taken the name ..., such as the one who launched the First Crusade

explanation.definitionFit: The first sense is the adjective for city life; the second is a papal name borne by several pontiffs.

clue.text: Chaste, but unlikely to be chased

definitions.meaning: pure, without moral stain or blemish
someone not noticed by pursuers is not seen, so nobody gives chase

explanation.definitionFit: Unblemished means morally pure, and not seen means nobody notices you to run after you.

clue.text: Barrels, and where they are pointed for rifle practice

definitions.meaning: large casks for wine or water

definitions.text: where they are pointed for rifle practice
definitions.meaning: the mounds or targets on a shooting range at which rifles are aimed

explanation.definitionFit: A cask of wine is one sense; the earth banks behind targets on a firing range are the other.

clue.text: A quick cleaner, likely to secure the record

parts.note: to fasten something down is to nail it
a file is a dossier or record kept on someone

explanation.surface: A speedy cleaning gadget that is bound to lock in the archive.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'quick' is the tender flesh under a fingernail, not an adjective for speed; this little tool cleans around it.
explanation.definitionFit: The quick is the sensitive skin beneath the nails, and this manicure tool tidies the nail edge beside it.

clue.text: He touches down after a circuit being a Scandinavian

indicators.note: the word placed after means the lander piece follows the circuit piece

parts.note: one circuit of a track is a lap
one who alights or lands is a lander

explanation.surface: A Nordic figure lands an aircraft after flying a loop.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of the far north of Norway, Sweden and Finland is a northern Scandinavian.

clue.text: Look with enthusiasm for a trademark

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or behold
go means energy or enthusiasm, as in full of go

explanation.surface: A brand's symbol you gaze at with eagerness.
explanation.definitionFit: A company's emblem or device identifies its goods, the same job a registered brand mark does.

clue.text: Sort of rent a landlord might sneeze at

definitions.text: Sort of rent a landlord might sneeze at

parts.words: Sort of rent a landlord might sneeze at
parts.note: a nominal rent is tiny enough for a landlord to scorn, and the spice berry behind its name makes people sneeze

explanation.walkthrough: To 'sneeze at' is to disdain, but the token rent is named after a grain of the spice that literally provokes sneezing.
explanation.definitionFit: A nominal token payment for a lease is called by this name, after a single grain of spice.

clue.text: Cold involving sort of light spasm

parts.note: an arc light is a kind of electric lamp
a tic is an involuntary twitch or spasm

explanation.surface: A chill bringing on a twitchy kind of flicker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involving' simply links the cold to the pieces that make it up.
explanation.definitionFit: Polar regions are freezing, so the adjective is used loosely for anything bitterly chilly.

clue.text: Sounds like a swell celebrity, but a weedy one

indicators.note: the words tell us to say the following pieces out loud

parts.note: a swell or fop is a dandy, and a celebrity is a lion, so these give dandy lion

explanation.surface: Something that seems to be a fashionable star but is in fact puny.
explanation.walkthrough: 'weedy' seems to mean feeble, but the plant is literally a garden weed.
explanation.definitionFit: This yellow-flowered plant is one of the commonest lawn weeds.

clue.text: Recover sufficiently for the big meeting

definitions.meaning: to pick up again after a setback, as markets or patients do
a mass gathering of supporters, such as a political demonstration

explanation.definitionFit: To bounce back after weakness is one sense; a mass political assembly is the other.

clue.text: Taking notice, but not of that early-to bed maxim

definitions.meaning: becoming alert, as in a person who suddenly pays attention

definitions.text: not of that early-to bed maxim
definitions.meaning: staying awake late at night, the opposite of the proverb early to bed, early to rise

explanation.definitionFit: To become attentive is one sense; staying out of bed late, against the old proverb, is the other.

clue.text: Maybe Panama queries Capone's ability

parts.note: can expresses being able to do something
Al Capone was the Chicago gangster, so Capone gives his first name

explanation.surface: Perhaps a hat-wearer doubts a gangster's skill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'queries' hints that the pieces form the question whether Al is able; Panama is an example, so 'Maybe' marks it.
explanation.definitionFit: The Panama waterway joining two oceans is a famous example of an artificial channel.

clue.text: It's a bit of a loss if youth has to become callous

indicators.note: only a portion of the following words is taken, the letters running across them

explanation.surface: Wasting young years makes a person grow hard-hearted.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn to bone is to harden, and figuratively a hardened, unfeeling person has grown insensitive.

clue.text: The way an address is given for a postal round

definitions.text: The way an address is given
definitions.meaning: the manner in which a speaker presents a speech
the post carried round and handed out to homes

explanation.definitionFit: A speaker's style of speaking is one sense; the bringing of mail to doors is the other.

clue.text: Treat friendly alien as an enemy subjectively

parts.note: with 'as an enemy' this means to detain someone in wartime, to intern them
a foreigner on your side is an ally

explanation.surface: Handle a well-disposed foreigner as a hostile one, judged from within.
explanation.walkthrough: The instruction 'Treat ... as an enemy' wraps round 'friendly alien': interning is what is done to enemy aliens in wartime.
explanation.definitionFit: Something felt within the mind rather than observed outside it is experienced inwardly, from the subject's own viewpoint.

clue.text: Sweater tucked in by a sleeping native of Galapagos

definitions.meaning: a jumper with a high close-fitting rolled collar

definitions.text: tucked in by a sleeping native of Galapagos
definitions.meaning: a giant tortoise of those islands pulls in its neck when resting

explanation.definitionFit: A pullover with a high folded collar is one sense; the reptile's retractable throat is the other.

clue.text: Barker describing the evening sun

definitions.meaning: a dog, here an Irish breed with a chestnut coat
the sun going down glows crimson as it sinks

explanation.definitionFit: An Irish gun dog breed is one sense; a crimson sinking sun is the other.

clue.text: Compete with a prospect

parts.note: to vie is to contend or compete

explanation.definitionFit: A prospect is a scene or outlook seen from a place, a panorama.

clue.text: Road toll, rather surprising at first for travellers on foot

parts.note: a way is a road or path
a fare is a charge paid for travel

indicators.note: only the opening letter of each of the two preceding words is used

explanation.surface: Walkers find a road charge rather a shock to begin with.
explanation.definitionFit: Wanderers who journey by road, especially walking, are wanderers on the move.

clue.text: Large paper beard

definitions.meaning: a big traditional size of writing or printing sheet
a small pointed tuft below the lower lip, as Napoleon III wore

explanation.definitionFit: A large sheet size is one sense; a pointed chin tuft is the other.

clue.text: It is dead — dead — dead

parts.note: the extinct flightless bird of the saying dead as a, the byword for something utterly gone

explanation.walkthrough: The triple 'dead' echoes the simile of complete extinction.
explanation.definitionFit: This Mauritian bird is extinct, and the phrase dead as one means utterly finished.

clue.text: The art of securing communications by a late call-up

definitions.text: The art of securing communications by a late call-up

parts.words: The art of securing communications by a late call-up
parts.note: the practice of summoning the departed to talk with them, where late means deceased and call-up means raising spirits

explanation.walkthrough: 'late' looks like tardy and 'call-up' like conscription, but they mean the dead and their summoning.
explanation.definitionFit: Sorcery that raises the spirits of the dead to foretell events is this black art.

clue.text: One who declares foreign coin

definitions.meaning: someone who states or announces something
an ancient Greek silver or gold coin

explanation.definitionFit: A person who states something is one sense; an ancient Greek coin is the other.

clue.text: Fiddling the central heating consumption

parts.note: CH is the usual abbreviation for central heating, as in house adverts
eating is the consuming of food

explanation.surface: Tampering with the home's warmth and how much it uses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'consumption' seems to be fuel use but gives the act of taking food.
explanation.definitionFit: To fiddle is slang for swindling or acting dishonestly.

clue.text: Inflammation of the throat or rump

definitions.meaning: a childhood illness of the larynx with a harsh barking cough
the hindquarters of a horse

explanation.definitionFit: A children's barking cough illness is one sense; a horse's hindquarters is the other.

clue.text: A Green group may be concerned with their welfare

definitions.text: A Green group may be concerned with their welfare

indicators.note: to group things is to arrange them, so these letters are sorted into a new order

explanation.surface: An environmentalist organisation could care about the wellbeing of various species.
explanation.walkthrough: Read whole, the clue says that environmental campaigners care for these biological classes.
explanation.definitionFit: Biological classes ranking above species, which conservationists aim to protect, are taxonomic groupings.

clue.text: Evolve Eastern dictator's title

parts.note: Il Duce was the title of Mussolini, the Italian dictator

explanation.surface: An oriental tyrant's rank is to develop.
explanation.definitionFit: To draw out or develop something latent is to bring it forth from within.

clue.text: No longer employed

definitions.meaning: as in ... to, meaning formerly but not now
put to use or utilised

explanation.definitionFit: Formerly, in the phrase of habit past, is one sense; utilised is the other.

clue.text: Eight lines of verse, etc, originally in the scriptures

indicators.note: one piece is placed within the other piece

parts.note: OT is the Old Testament, the first part of the Christian scriptures

indicators.note: in an original or novel way, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An eight-line stanza and such, first found in the Bible.
explanation.walkthrough: 'originally' seems to mean at first but signals CTE, a rearrangement of ETC, placed in OT.
explanation.definitionFit: The first eight lines of a sonnet form a stanza of that length.

clue.text: Languor of a girl with sex appeal due to model

parts.note: a lass is a girl
it is old slang for sex appeal, as in the It girl

indicators.note: to model is to shape, so these letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: Weariness of an alluring young woman awaiting a fashion shoot.
explanation.definitionFit: Listlessness and lack of energy is the state of weariness.

clue.text: Depicted a harbour spread out

parts.note: a port is a harbour
rayed means radiating out in rays

explanation.surface: A painted port scene stretching wide.
explanation.definitionFit: To depict is to represent in a picture or description.

clue.text: Observations made by lechers right in their wine dregs

indicators.note: one piece is placed within the other piece

parts.note: lees are the sediment at the bottom of wine

explanation.surface: Lustful drinkers ogle as the bottle empties to the sediment.
explanation.definitionFit: Lascivious sidelong glances are the looks a lecher gives.
